title: fix(mcp,platform-objects): SSO provider, OAuth application and Connect-an-Agent copy says "this system" (cloud#3002 ruling A)
body:
Fixes #24405

Clause-②: no (copy only: no accept set or public surface moves; owes the seat's review of record at `TIER_DEFAULT` before the queue)

## What changed

objectstack-ai/cloud#3002 ruling A, as triage applied it (`6250167038` on #24327, `6252585695` on #24368): "made here, not from a package" reads "authored in this system"; the system the caller is in drops the noun or says "this system"; a string that means a deployment or configuration scope keeps its word. Every string the card lists was read and is either changed or left with its reason below.

| site (by symbol) | before | after | reading |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `sys_oauth_application` grid `all_apps`, `emptyState.message` (`sys-oauth-application.object.ts`) | ... sign users in with this environment. | ... sign users in with this system. | the system the user is in: "this system" |
| `sys_sso_provider` object `description` (`sys-sso-provider.object.ts`) | External SSO identity providers (OIDC / SAML) this environment federates login to | ... this system federates login to | same |
| `sys_sso_provider` action `register_sso_provider`, param `clientId` help text | OAuth client ID issued by the IdP for this environment. | ... for this system. | same: the relying party the IdP registered is the running system; no environment is contrasted with another |
| Connect-an-Agent `page:header` subtitle (`packages/mcp/src/connect-ui.ts`, `CONNECT_AGENT_PAGE`) and its `en` copy (`platform-objects` `en.ts`, `pages.connect_agent.subtitle`) | Give any MCP-capable AI client governed access to this environment — ... | Give any MCP-capable AI client governed access to this system — every call runs under the caller's own permissions and row-level security. | the sentence #24404 chose; both literals in ONE commit (317fadc2) |
| `deletePackage`'s retired-key refusal (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`) | An uninstall is environment-wide — it removes every row bound to the package in this environment — so no organization scope is stated or confirmed. | **kept** | a deployment/configuration scope: "environment-wide" is ADR-0131 D6's name for the row scope that is not an organization's (`organizationId: null`), and the sentence exists to contrast that scope with the organization scope the retired key used to pick. "in this environment" restates the extent of that same scope; renaming it alone would break the contrast the refusal is built on. The sibling remedy in the same file ("the write then lands environment-wide, where every organization reads it.") uses the same vocabulary and is not on this card either. |
| `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts`, permission set `packageId` help text ("... created in this environment.") | — | **kept, not regenerated** | it follows `packages/spec/src/security/permission.form.ts`, which is #24406 (`domain:spec`, open). The spec source still says "created in this environment" on `origin/main` `e22defb13`, so regenerating changes nothing; it is never hand-edited. #24406 remains open for it. |
| `sys_metadata_activation` object description | — | untouched | already "authored in this system" on `main` (PR #24401); verified, not touched |

**Translations.** The same phrase in the translated leaves is re-translated by hand, as AGENTS.md allows for translated-locale values:

- Connect-an-Agent subtitle: zh-CN 此环境 → 本系统, ja-JP この環境 → このシステム, es-ES este entorno → este sistema, in `zh-CN.ts`, `ja-JP.ts`, `es-ES.ts`. The recorded source hash `pages.connect_agent.subtitle` in the three `*.source-hashes.ts` files moves from `2d0f9a000824e78a` to `b0d7c6d174511bcb`, computed with `hashSource` from `source-hash.ts` (control: the same call on the old English text returns `2d0f9a000824e78a`, the recorded value).
- The three object strings in `zh-CN` / `ja-JP` / `es-ES.objects.generated.ts`, the same substitution. None of the three leaves has an entry in any `*.source-hashes.generated.ts` (they are legacy-trusted translator text), so no generated hash moves; `check-i18n-bundles --write` kept all six hand values and rewrote only the three `en` leaves.

No code, status, error code or envelope field changes. Nothing else in `packages/mcp` moves.

## The fallback, measured

`packages/cli/test/platform-page-i18n-parity.test.ts`, through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, after building the CLI closure:

- Both English literals and the three translations changed, hashes NOT moved (WIP commit, since squashed): `Tests 1 failed | 26 passed (27)`; the red test is "rewrites the page:header copy end-to-end for a non-English locale" (the zh-CN subtitle fell back to English).
- Hashes moved: `Tests 27 passed (27)`.

So the hashes are load-bearing: without them every non-English locale silently serves English.

## Pins

The parity test is the one consumer that parses this text (it holds the `en` bundle byte-identical to the page literal), and it is green with the new sentence on both sides. No other test, fixture, docs page, skill or platform-checklist item quotes any of the changed strings (`git grep` over the tree). `packages/rest/src/rest.test.ts` and `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.test.ts` carry a zh-CN fixture ending 受控访问此环境。 — it is each test's own inline translation fixture, not read from this bundle, so it pins nothing here (and `packages/spec` is outside this card).

## Verification (head d9ac89199, after merging `origin/main` `e22defb13`)

- Build: CLI closure (`--filter '@objectstack/cli^...'`) `VERDICT command-exit 0`; the `check:i18n` prerequisite closure `61 successful, 61 total`; full `turbo run build --concurrency=2` `77 successful, 77 total`. After the last merge: `@objectstack/mcp` + `@objectstack/platform-objects` rebuilt, exit 0.
- Typecheck (after the last merge): `@objectstack/mcp` exit 0, `@objectstack/platform-objects` exit 0, `@objectstack/cli` (test-only consumer) exit 0, each with `check:test-typecheck` green.
- Tests: `@objectstack/platform-objects` `Test Files 77 passed (77)`, `Tests 1184 passed (1184)`; `@objectstack/mcp` `Test Files 40 passed (40)`, `Tests 479 passed (479)`; `@objectstack/cli` `test/platform-page-i18n-parity.test.ts` `Tests 27 passed (27)` (re-run after the last merge: 27 passed).
- `pnpm check:i18n`: `OK (10 package(s) — all bundles in sync, no undeclared authoring keys)`.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths) on d9ac89199 derived 59 commands; all 59 exit 0 (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, on the first run and exit 0 after the full build). `--ran`: `Run reconciliation — 59 derived, 59 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the 10 changed `.ts` source files: exit 0.
- `test:repo` not run locally (CI `Test Core`).

## Acceptance notes

- `en.objects.generated.ts`'s `sys_metadata_history` description "... (environment-wide, append-only)" is the same ADR-0131 D6 scope word and not on this card's list. Left.
- `packages/mcp/src/connect-ui.ts`'s bundle `description` (about `:84`) already reads "... to this system." on `main` (PR #24413); not touched. `mcp-server-runtime.ts`'s `:1448` text is a `logger.warn` line, and `skill-md.ts`'s "ObjectStack environment" names a deployment addressed from outside; both are #24404's readings and outside this card.
- `plugin-auth`'s `auth-schema-config.ts` comment "OIDC/SAML IdP this environment federates login to" is a code comment and `domain:services`' (#24368); not touched.
- #24406 is not addressed here; it remains open for the `permission.form.ts` help text and its generated `en` leaf.
